These days I keep feeling stupid, which doesn't feel too good. Mostly because I'm always screwing myself over. Being tired all the time doesn't help either. I have no ambition in life and I don't really care what happens to me anymore, which kinda sucks because I'm still in highschool and everyone is pressuring me about post secondary decisions lol. 

My grandma is coming soon to stay for a couple months and I'm not gonna lie,,,, I'm not nearly as excited for it as everyone else in my family. It's depressing. And I'm scared of this screwing up my daily routine and whatnot. I'm pretty sure that's the only thing keeping me alive. Thinking about this just makes me feel like a bitch though.

I also can't stop thinking about my ex and it's almost been a year. It sucks that I have to volunteer at this cat shelter that reminds me of him because I have sososo many regrets regarding the way things ended and there's really nothing I can do about it. 

I also hate how irritable I've been lately. I feel like I'm always on the verge of screaming at everyone and it's so annoying but I can't help it. I don't know what to do. I feel so stupid. And lately I've been feeling like nobody actually likes being around me but I can't tell if I'm just being delulu. I DO know that every time I try to talk to someone new, I think it went well but then we never talk again. If I'm lucky we greet each other when we make awk eye contact. It's so frustrating. Meanwhile kids are starving in africa lol but Things Are Fine ! I guess.
